name: Omorikaigan
tagline: Shinagawa in 11 minutes and Tokyo in 25 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Keikyu Main Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 31 minutes to Otemachi, 42 minutes to Shinjuku, 37 minutes to Shibuya and 11 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 2.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.4 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 2.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.6 m to 3 m, a difference of 1.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 6 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 7 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: イトーヨーカドー 大森店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is いすゞ病院, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 中島病院, about 22 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Keikyu Main Line.
congestion: Keikyu Main Line runs at 120% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 戸部→横浜, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Omori is ahead on how close the centre is and lower rent.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Omorikaigan. Omori has the JR Keihin-Tohoku Line, a different set from Omorikaigan. To Shinjuku, for instance, Omori is 12 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥7,000 less at Omori. On the number of places to eat out, Omori comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Heiwajima; for the number of medical facilities, Omorikaigan.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Omorikaigan. It is served by the same lines as Omorikaigan. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥11,000 less at Heiwajima. On the number of places to eat out, Omorikaigan comes out ahead.

goodFor: People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: The 首都高速1号羽田線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
第一京浜 (4 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 5 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Keikyu Main Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
